sloka: भक्षयन्तीम् मृगान् भीमान् विकटाम् मुक्त मूर्धजाम् ।अवैक्षताम् तु तौ तत्र भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥३-६९-१३॥
transliteration: bhakṣayantīm mṛgān bhīmān vikaṭām mukta mūrdhajām ।avaikṣatām tu tau tatra bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥3-69-13॥

translations.english: Then the two brothers saw a fearful demoness who could strike terror in the mind of the timid, an uncouth figure with huge curved skins, with a big stomach, dishevelled hair, sharp and long teeth, devouring wild animals.
